_comment: Copy this file to deploy.config.json and fill in your server.
deploy.config.json is gitignored: this repository is public, so the
host and account name stay out of it.
port         SSH port (22 unless your host says otherwise)
path         folder the site is served from, relative to the SSH home
directory or absolute. Everything in it is mirrored from
_site/, and anything in it that _site/ does not have is
deleted, so point it at the site folder and nothing wider.
identityFile SSH key to use; null lets ssh pick the usual one
exclude      rsync patterns kept on the server and never deleted,
